title: Jess Pava
description: Sometimes known as "Testor", Jess Pava was a brave, young pilot in the Resistance, flying against the First Order. Though she grew up idolizing pilots like Luke Skywalker and Wedge Antilles, she became a great pilot of legend like them in her own right. She flew with Poe Dameron and others against Starkiller Base under the call sign Blue Three.
